sourcePoseAuditScope: Prior expression and droplet audits document their creation. The hand-adjustment audit compares all 30 source poses with the preceding version; the fuse audit checks all 39 final frames.

facePreservation.reference: Per-frame expression artwork; original face outside eyes and beak

flipperPreservation.measurement: White flipper caps after body-sway alignment; area and aspect compared with base
